svg.title: Build 007: The Product That Learns — official-source context cover
svg.desc: Official NIST AI RMF GOVERN 5 excerpt describing a governed feedback loop that incorporates adjudicated external feedback into AI-system design and implementation. Bounded official-source excerpt; not evidence of prototype performance or institutional endorsement.
svg.text: Processes are in place for robust engagement with relevant AI
GOVERN 5.1: Organizational policies and practices are in place to
consider, prioritize, and integrate feedback from those external to
that developed or deployed the AI system regarding the potential
and societal impacts related to AI risks.
GOVERN 5.2: Mechanisms are established to enable the team that
or deployed AI systems to regularly incorporate adjudicated feedback
relevant AI actors into system design and implementation.
NIST AI RMF GOVERN 5: external feedback is collected, adjudicated and incorporated
Supports a governed product-learning feedback loop; it does not show that Build 007 implements
NIST, learns correctly or improves outcomes.
